pages.title: BiConcept — Architecture, Interiors & Real Estate
pages.description: BiConcept conceives architecture, interior design, and real estate as one idea. A conceptual studio for homes, developments, and land across India.

faqs.question: What does BiConcept do?
faqs.answer: BiConcept is a conceptual studio for architecture, interior design, and real estate — from first sketch to occupied space and land.

faqs.question: Where does BiConcept work?
faqs.answer: We work across India, with selected commissions further afield when the brief asks for a single, coherent concept.

pages.title: Architecture — BiConcept
pages.description: Architectural design by BiConcept: villas, residences, and developments composed as enduring spatial ideas.

faqs.question: What architecture work does BiConcept take on?
faqs.answer: Villas, residences, and developments — from first massing through construction, held as a single spatial idea.

faqs.question: Do you handle planning drawings?
faqs.answer: Yes. Concept, planning, detailed architectural sets, and site coordination are part of the architecture practice.

pages.title: Interior Design — BiConcept
pages.description: Interior design by BiConcept: material, light, and proportion composed for how a space is actually lived.

faqs.question: Is interior design a separate service?
faqs.answer: It is its own practice, but it is composed the way we compose buildings — light, material, and furniture as one temperature.

faqs.question: Do you specify furniture and lighting?
faqs.answer: Yes. Layouts, custom millwork, FF&E, and styling through installation.

pages.title: Real Estate — BiConcept
pages.description: Real estate advisory by BiConcept: land, residences, and developments selected and shaped with a designer’s eye.

faqs.question: Is this a brokerage?
faqs.answer: We advise on residences, plots, and developments with a designer’s eye — selecting and shaping property as a long idea, not a listing mill.

faqs.question: Can architecture follow a land purchase?
faqs.answer: Yes. When the brief continues, we hand off into architecture or interiors after close.

pages.description: Upcoming and newly launched projects in Delhi, Noida, and Greater Noida, researched for BiConcept clients. Filter by city and sector.

faqs.question: Which cities does BiConcept research?
faqs.answer: Delhi, Noida, and Greater Noida — including named sectors. Listings are researched publicly and published only after studio review.

faqs.question: Are these BiConcept developments?
faqs.answer: No. These are public-market projects we research so a client can brief the studio against a real pocket, not a brochure.
